subject: Media Literacy
title: Press Freedom and Its Limits
description: One-minute skill: Press Freedom and Its Limits.

hook.text: A newspaper publishes leaked military plans. Lives are endangered. The government demands censorship. Who is right?

buildup.text: Press freedom protects media's ability to inform the public without government interference. It's fundamental to democracy.

discovery.text: But press freedom isn't absolute. National security, privacy, and incitement to violence create legitimate boundaries.

twist.text: Governments often claim 'national security' to suppress embarrassing truths. The limits are fought over constantly.

climax.text: Free press is essential. But so is responsibility. The tension between the two defines democratic society.

punchline.text: Press freedom is a right. Responsible use of it is a duty.

quiz.question: Why are limits on press freedom controversial?
options: Governments may claim security concerns to suppress legitimate reporting
Press freedom has no limits anywhere
